title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: - Added RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts for Python/TS. - New docs site quickstart: RAG + Agent tool-calling. - Example playbooks and test harness for local verification.
body: Summary: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG agent templates, language-specific tool-calling examples (Python and TypeScript), and a docs-site quickstart that walks users from ingestion to a running agent with tool integrations. Context & Motivation: We continue to see customers adopt Retrieval-Augmented Generation and agents; however, onboarding is still a recurring friction point: developers ask for end-to-end examples that include embedding ingestion, a simple vector store, agent templates (planner + tool-runner), and safe tool-calling patterns. This PR consolidates recommended templates and maps them into docs quickstarts so users can get started in <30 minutes. Changes: - docs/rag/agent-templates.md: new canonical templates (Planner-only, Tool-calling agent, RAG-without-agent) - redwood-examples/rag/tool-calling/python/example_agent.py: Python example using redwood-sdk-python + local FAISS store - redwood-examples/rag/tool-calling/typescript/exampleAgent.ts: TS example using redwood-sdk-typescript + Weaviate/embeddings stub - redwood-examples/rag/playbooks/: sample playbooks for common flows (faq-bot, support-triage) - redwood-docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md: step-by-step quickstart with config snippets, recommended model pins, and troubleshooting - docs/diagrams/agent-architecture.svg: updated diagram (exported from Figma) - test/harness/rag-agent-smoke-test.sh: small smoke test used in CI - minor wording and cross-linking updates across the docs site Commits (summary): "init: add agent templates and python example", "feat(ts): add typescript tool-calling example and README", "docs: add quickstart and cross-links", "test: add smoke test and CI job", "chore: fix linting and formatting" Changed files (high level): list below. Testing and CI: Added a docs-site build (Netlify) preview job and a new lightweight smoke test in the mono-repo CI. All CI checks passed on final push; smoke test runs locally in ~45s against a mini FAISS fixture. Backwards compatibility: non-breaking; templates are additive. Rollout plan: merge to main and monitor docs analytics + quickstart adoption; follow up with additional language examples if adoption warrants. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Add quickstart to docs site - [x] Add smoke tests - [x] CI green - [x] Reviews addressed
